messages:
toni: quick thread to pin down a lean launch for the Optimize toolkit pilot (batching, prefix caching, quant fallbacks, eval alerts). customers: MediFast (latency-sensitive) and ChatForge (cost-sensitive). can we agree a minimal scope today?
ben: yes. propose two product profiles + a safety path. call them: Sprint (latency), Thrift (cost), and Sentinel (safety/canary).
leila: Sprint defaults: tiny batches, eager prefix prefetch, avoid quant. target p95 <= 260ms on 1-2 turn dialogues. Thrift defaults: larger batching, int8 fallback allowed behind gate, prioritize per-token cost.
frank: Sentinel = experiment lane with eval-driven gating and rollback hooks. run evals every 5m and surface alerts. infra-bot: eval-runner v1.3 is live and posts to /monitor/events with tags: pilot,customer,variant,metric_delta.
toni: acceptance criteria suggestion:
- Sprint: p95 <= 260ms on canonical short-chat load (measured over 1 hour)
- Thrift: >= 18% per-token cost reduction vs baseline over a 12h sampling window
- Quant fallback: auto-enable only if customer's golden set shows metric drift <= 2.0% vs FP32
- Eval alerts: alert visible in console + notification to slack/oncall within 4m; attach up to 5 failing examples and recent request ids
ben: how big should golden sets be?
leila: recommend 75-150 prompts. provide a default templated set customers can start from. allow upload via CLI.
frank: runtime note: cross-variant KV compatibility is not implemented. fallback will create cold-state variants and incur warm-up token overhead. need to document warm-up cost and restrict fallbacks to X/minute per customer.
toni: rollout plan:
- day 0: publish one-pager + opt-in flag for Thrift
- day 2: runtime changes (batching profiles + fallback gate) behind feature flag
- day 5: enable Sentinel canary at 3% traffic for 72h with continuous evals and shadowing
- widen if no critical alerts
ben: sample batching YAML for Thrift (POC):
```yaml
profile: thrift
max_batch_items: 40
max_tokens_per_batch: 6144
latency_target_ms: 800
prefix_caching: opportunistic
```
leila: alert trig rule draft: sustained metric delta > threshold for 4 minutes OR >2% of recent requests failing semantic-sim threshold -> surface P0/P1 based on impact; include runbook link.
frank: infra asks: add a fallback rate limiter and a cache-warmup budget guard. I'll own the infra ticket. infra-bot: ticket INF-4602 created for fallback throttle.
toni: owners: ben (product + docs), leila (acceptance + customer comms), frank (runtime + infra). Action items: ben to write one-pager, frank to open runtime PR, leila to draft eval thresholds for each customer.
ben: small UX ask: show an "impact preview" before enabling Thrift for a customer using their golden set (cost delta + expected p95 change). CLI name: `ri optimize preview-impact`
leila: +1. SE onboarding should include quick local validation: `ri optimize validate --golden myset.json --variant int8` returns pass/fail and 5 example diffs.
frank: risks: noisy eval triggers, warm-up costs, customers with tiny golden sets producing unstable signals. mitigations: require sustained signals, recommend >=75 prompts, run multi-tenant shadowing for 48h pre-launch.
toni: timeline: finish one-pager + acceptance matrix by EOD Friday, runtime PR by next Tue, canary rollout next week. next sync Monday 9am PT.
leila: noted. I'll prepare the templated golden set and thresholds.
ben: adding these notes to the roadmap card.
frank: acknowledged.
toni: decision: proceed with Sprint/Thrift/Sentinel lanes, owners and acceptance criteria as above. follow-up Mon 9am PT.
leila: :thumbsup:
ben: thanks everyone.
